name: Culprit Finder
description: Diagnostic-only frame pacing investigator. Captures CPU draw and update hook-chain timings, asynchronous GPU timer-query data when supported, PlayerObject input timing, registered hook inventory, iOS memory and thermal snapshots, and detailed spike reports in its own mod save folder. Does not alter gameplay.

enabled.name: Enable Capture
enabled.description: Enable frame-time and player-input diagnostics. Does not change gameplay.

spike-threshold-ms.name: Frame Spike Threshold (ms)
spike-threshold-ms.description: Capture a frame when its start-to-start gap reaches this threshold. 20 ms is a useful starting point for a 60 Hz device.

show-overlay.name: Show Last Spike Overlay
show-overlay.description: Show a compact seven-second in-level summary after a detected spike. The full report is written to CulpritFinder-Capture.txt in this mod's save folder.

gpu-timer.name: GPU Timer Query
gpu-timer.description: Use asynchronous GL_EXT_disjoint_timer_query if the active iOS OpenGL ES renderer advertises it and exports the required functions. No glFinish or synchronous GPU wait is used. If unavailable, the report says so.

platform-snapshot.name: Capture iOS Memory and Thermal State
platform-snapshot.description: Sample resident/virtual memory, device physical memory, processor count, and iOS thermal state when a detailed spike report is captured.

hook-inventory.name: Include Hook Inventory
hook-inventory.description: List enabled and disabled Geode hooks attached to the monitored function addresses, including mod ID, display name, modify class, address, and priority. Function timers measure the downstream hook chain as a whole.

frame-timeline.name: Include Recent Frame Timeline
frame-timeline.description: Include the twelve most recent frame gaps, CPU draw timings, engine deltas, and completed GPU timings in detailed reports.

report-cooldown-ms.name: Detailed Report Cooldown (ms)
report-cooldown-ms.description: Avoid flooding the capture file during a continuous hitch burst. Every spike still gets a compact file entry and increments the counter; coalesced events are counted.
